globalThis.comparison=(()=>{
 const checks={},v=Number(globalThis.variant)||0,near=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<.1;
 const sheet=document.createElement('style');sheet.textContent='html,body{margin:0;padding:0}';document.head.append(sheet);
 const make=(css,count=4,tag='div')=>{const box=document.createElement(tag);box.style.cssText='display:grid;width:'+(320+v*2)+'px;font:16px/20px serif;'+css;for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const child=document.createElement('div');child.style.cssText='height:20px;min-width:0';box.append(child);}document.body.append(box);return box;};
 const width=320+v*2;
 const run=(name,css,callback,count=4)=>{const box=make(css,count);checks[name]=callback(box,[...box.children].map(node=>node.getBoundingClientRect()),box.getBoundingClientRect());box.remove();};
 run('fraction','grid-template-columns:1fr 3fr',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,width/4)&&near(r[1].width,width*3/4)&&near(r[2].y-r[0].y,20));
 run('gap','grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:10px;row-gap:7px',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,(width-10)/2)&&near(r[1].x-r[0].x,(width+10)/2)&&near(r[2].y-r[0].y,27));
 run('fixed','grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr)',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,40)&&near(r[1].width,width-40));
 run('percent','grid-template-columns:25% 75%',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,width/4)&&near(r[1].width,width*3/4));
 run('relative','grid-template-columns:2em 3rem 1fr',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,32)&&near(r[1].width,48)&&near(r[2].width,width-80));
 run('repeatMultiple','grid-template-columns:repeat(2,20px 1fr)',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,20)&&near(r[2].width,20)&&near(r[1].width,(width-40)/2));
 run('rows','grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:30px 50px',(b,r,rect)=>near(rect.height,80)&&near(r[2].y-r[0].y,30));
 run('autoRows','grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:35px',(b,r,rect)=>near(rect.height,70)&&near(r[2].y-r[0].y,35));
 run('span','grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)',(b,r)=>{b.firstElementChild.style.gridColumn='span 2';r=[...b.children].map(node=>node.getBoundingClientRect());return near(r[0].width,width*2/3)&&near(r[1].x-r[0].x,width*2/3)&&near(r[2].y-r[0].y,20);});
 run('explicitLine','grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)',(b,r)=>{b.firstElementChild.style.gridColumn='2 / 4';r=[...b.children].map(node=>node.getBoundingClientRect());return near(r[0].width,width*2/3)&&near(r[0].x-r[1].x,width/3);});
 run('negativeLine','grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)',(b,r)=>{b.firstElementChild.style.gridColumn='1 / -1';return near(b.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().width,width);});
 run('rowSpan','grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:30px',(b,r)=>{b.firstElementChild.style.gridRow='span 2';return near(b.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().height,20)&&near(b.children[2].getBoundingClientRect().y-b.children[1].getBoundingClientRect().y,30);});
 run('mutation','grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr',(b,r)=>{b.style.gridTemplateColumns='1fr 3fr';return near(b.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().width,width/4);});
 run('variable','--tracks:30px minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-columns:var(--tracks)',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,30)&&near(r[1].width,width-30));
 run('math','grid-template-columns:calc(20px + 2em) 1fr',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,52)&&near(r[1].width,width-52));
 run('autoColumns','grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:25px',(b,r)=>r.every(rect=>near(rect.width,25)));
 run('minmax','grid-template-columns:minmax(20px,50px) 1fr',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,50)&&near(r[1].width,width-50));
 run('fitContent','grid-template-columns:fit-content(50px) 1fr',(b,r)=>near(r[0].width,0)&&near(r[1].width,width));
 const list=make('display:flex;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;gap:8px',3,'ol');for(const child of list.children)child.style.cssText='width:30px;height:20px';const lr=[...list.children].map(node=>node.getBoundingClientRect());checks.flexList=near(lr[1].x-lr[0].x,38)&&near(list.getBoundingClientRect().height,20);list.remove();
 const ul=make('margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr',2,'ul');checks.gridList=near(ul.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().width,width/2);ul.remove();
 const flowList=document.createElement('ul');flowList.style.cssText='list-style:none;font:16px/20px serif';const item=document.createElement('li');item.style.cssText='width:30px;height:20px';flowList.append(item);document.body.append(flowList);checks.listDefaults=near(item.getBoundingClientRect().x,40)&&near(item.getBoundingClientRect().y-flowList.getBoundingClientRect().y,0);checks.listItemDisplay=getComputedStyle(item).display==='list-item';flowList.style.cssText='list-style:none;display:flex;margin:0;padding:0;gap:10px';const item2=document.createElement('li');item2.style.cssText='width:30px;height:20px';flowList.append(item2);checks.inheritedMarkerless=near(item2.getBoundingClientRect().x-item.getBoundingClientRect().x,40);flowList.remove();
 sheet.remove();return checks;
})();
